rationale: In this final wave, we are deploying all three remaining drones to resolve critical life-safety questions and sweep high-occupancy unscanned blocks. D1 will verify trapped survivors and active fire along the California and Pine corridor, D2 will resolve high-occupancy damage disagreements near Embarcadero Center and the Federal Reserve, and D3 will survey unscanned high-risk blocks at Rincon Annex and the Pacific Gas & Electric Building. No drones are held in reserve as this is the final wave and AIR 1 has completed its scan.

missions.purpose: Assess fire at 201 California St and confirm trapped survivors at 100 Battery, 433 California, and California Bank and Trust.
Resolve damage disagreements and check for trapped occupants at Embarcadero Center 3, Hyatt Regency, Federal Reserve, and Matson Building.
Survey unscanned, densely occupied structures at Rincon Annex and the SoMa steel block at Pacific Gas & Electric Building.
